scope: development profiling and held-out correctness only; no fitting or policy evaluation
checkpoint_indices: unique sorted: 0, 1, floor(first_proof_step/2), first_proof_step-1; all strictly before first proof
candidate_set: every pending candidate with maximum native confidence at each sampled state

timing.candidate_order: independently shuffled per pass, schedule saved before execution

exclusions: retain all rows; flag instrumentation-unresolved rows as ineligible for fitting rather than discarding evidence
model_status: no trained model; exploratory feature checks use development data only
